discovery_candidates.title: Brookings Police Policy 13D1
discovery_candidates.claim: Original department Policy 13D1 displays effective date April 24, 2024 and revised date September 22, 2026; page 5 states ALPR reads and hits are retained for a maximum of 30 days except records held for an investigation.
discovery_candidates.caveat: The revised policy document does not establish the precise textual changes from any previous version.

discovery_candidates.title: San Bruno Flock ALPR Q1/Q2 2026 audit
discovery_candidates.claim: The department reports 3,149,556 partner-agency searches in its January–June 2026 audit; it identified 29 searches warranting deeper review, 23 associated with NCRIC, and states NCRIC access was removed.
discovery_candidates.caveat: Department-reported findings; suspected indirect sharing is not an adjudicated privacy-law violation. Search totals describe a multi-month interval.

discovery_candidates.title: San Bruno December 2025 Flock audit
discovery_candidates.claim: The report states 1,238 internal and 461,711 partner searches for the December 2025 audit and reports 66 total cameras, 46 operational.
discovery_candidates.caveat: Report itself bears an anomalous memorandum date of January 5, 2025 while describing December 2025 and a period extending to January 2026; its chronology requires agency confirmation.

discovery_candidates.title: Green Bay Police September 2026 ALPR monthly report
discovery_candidates.claim: The October 1, 2026 report lists 443,664 unique plate reads, 9,534 hotlist hits, 522 user search sessions, and four organizations granted access to Green Bay PD data.
discovery_candidates.caveat: Aggregate agency statements do not prove any particular data search, recipient query or current sharing beyond the dated report.

discovery_candidates.title: Robbinsdale Police Policy 427
discovery_candidates.claim: The official department policy index names Policy 427 and links this PDF, but the exact document content was not accessible for a page-level review.
discovery_candidates.caveat: A government source hyperlink is not independent examination of the policy PDF.

discovery_candidates.title: San Bruno current ALPR policy
discovery_candidates.claim: The official San Bruno ALPR program page names the current policy and links this PDF, but the precise PDF has a redirect loop in the retrieval channel.
discovery_candidates.caveat: Do not substitute the accessible historical 2023 policy manual for this newer version.

comparative_research_findings.claim: The December 2025 report lists 66 total/46 operational cameras; the Q1–Q2 2026 report lists 59 total/51 operational cameras and 29 additional searches needing investigation.
comparative_research_findings.caveat: Reports cover different durations. The 2025 PDF's own date conflicts with its December 2025 audit label; these reports are not a before/after version of the same policy document.
